description: Build, edit and render JangaFX IlluGen node graphs (textures, VFX) from your AI agent.

tool_signatures.name: annotation_add
tool_signatures.description: Adds a comment to the node graph: a framed group around nodes, or a free text note.

kind.description: 'group' = framed comment box drawn behind nodes; 'note' = free text label.

text.description: Comment of the group, or text of the note.

around_nodes.description: Groups: ids or labels of the nodes to frame; position and size are computed from them.

position.description: [x, y] top-left corner. Required unless around_nodes is given.

size.description: [width, height]. Default 600 x 400 for a group, 460 x 60 for a note.

color_idx.description: Groups: color index of the frame. 0 = default color.

parameters.name: around_nodes
parameters.description: Groups: ids or labels of the nodes to frame; position and size are computed from them.

parameters.name: color_idx
parameters.description: Groups: color index of the frame. 0 = default color.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: 'group' = framed comment box drawn behind nodes; 'note' = free text label.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: [x, y] top-left corner. Required unless around_nodes is given.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: [width, height]. Default 600 x 400 for a group, 460 x 60 for a note.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Comment of the group, or text of the note.

tool_signatures.name: annotation_remove
tool_signatures.description: Deletes one group or note annotation from the node graph.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Index in project_summary.annotations.groups or .notes (0-based).

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Kind of annotation to remove.

tool_signatures.name: curve_set
tool_signatures.description: Replaces all the keys of a node's curve (remap curves, custom oscillator waveforms...).

curve.description: Curve name as shown by node_get or describe_node_type, e.g. Noise 'Final remap', Levels 'Main remap', Oscillator 'custom_waveform'.

points.description: At least 2 keys: [[position, value], ...] (positions usually 0..1), or dicts {position, value, interpolation} to vary the interpolation per key.

interpolation.description: Interpolation for keys that do not set their own.

parameters.name: curve
parameters.description: Curve name as shown by node_get or describe_node_type, e.g. Noise 'Final remap', Levels 'Main remap', Oscillator 'custom_waveform'.

parameters.name: interpolation
parameters.description: Interpolation for keys that do not set their own.

parameters.name: points
parameters.description: At least 2 keys: [[position, value], ...] (positions usually 0..1), or dicts {position, value, interpolation} to vary the interpolation per key.

tool_signatures.name: describe_node_type
tool_signatures.description: Describes one node type: its parameters, curves and typed input/output pins.

node_type.description: Node type name from list_node_types. Case, spaces and the 'Node_' prefix are optional, e.g. 'grayscale noise' for Node_Grayscale_Noise.

parameters.name: node_type
parameters.description: Node type name from list_node_types. Case, spaces and the 'Node_' prefix are optional, e.g. 'grayscale noise' for Node_Grayscale_Noise.

tool_signatures.name: gradient_set
tool_signatures.description: Replaces a node's color gradient (Color Ramp, Color Interpolate, Geometry Combine Color...).

stops.description: At least one stop: [[position 0..1, color], ...], color as [r, g, b, a] floats 0..1 or '#rrggbb[aa]'.

color_space.description: Interpolation space between stops. Empty = keep the current one.

index.description: Which gradient of the node, for nodes with several. 0 = first.

parameters.name: color_space
parameters.description: Interpolation space between stops. Empty = keep the current one.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Which gradient of the node, for nodes with several. 0 = first.

parameters.name: stops
parameters.description: At least one stop: [[position 0..1, color], ...], color as [r, g, b, a] floats 0..1 or '#rrggbb[aa]'.

tool_signatures.name: illugen_status
tool_signatures.description: Reports whether IlluGen is installed and which node catalog this server uses.

tool_signatures.name: link_add
tool_signatures.description: Connects an output pin of one node to an input pin of another.

from_node.description: Source node id or unique label.

from_pin.description: Output pin name on the source node (see describe_node_type).

to_node.description: Destination node id or unique label.

to_pin.description: Input pin name on the destination node: a regular input, a parameter pin or a subgraph input.

modulation_range.description: Only for parameter pins: [min, max] in 0..1 of the parameter range the Signal sweeps, or one [min, max] pair per vector component. Default: the full range.

parameters.name: from_node
parameters.description: Source node id or unique label.

parameters.name: from_pin
parameters.description: Output pin name on the source node (see describe_node_type).

parameters.name: modulation_range
parameters.description: Only for parameter pins: [min, max] in 0..1 of the parameter range the Signal sweeps, or one [min, max] pair per vector component. Default: the full range.

parameters.name: to_node
parameters.description: Destination node id or unique label.

parameters.name: to_pin
parameters.description: Input pin name on the destination node: a regular input, a parameter pin or a subgraph input.

tool_signatures.name: link_remove
tool_signatures.description: Disconnects an input pin: removes the link(s) arriving at `to_pin` of `to_node`.

to_node.description: Node id or unique label whose input is disconnected.

from_node.description: Optional: only remove links coming from this node (id or unique label). Empty = from any node.

parameters.name: from_node
parameters.description: Optional: only remove links coming from this node (id or unique label). Empty = from any node.

parameters.name: to_node
parameters.description: Node id or unique label whose input is disconnected.

parameters.name: to_pin
parameters.description: Input pin name to disconnect.

tool_signatures.name: list_node_types
tool_signatures.description: Lists the IlluGen node types this server can create, grouped by category.

category.description: Keep only this category (exact name, case-insensitive): Grayscale, Color, UV, Normal, Geometry, Utils, Islands, Export, Import, Particle, Camera, Time or Misc. Empty = all categories.

search.description: Keep only type names containing this text (case-insensitive), e.g. 'noise'. Empty = no filter.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Keep only this category (exact name, case-insensitive): Grayscale, Color, UV, Normal, Geometry, Utils, Islands, Export, Import, Particle, Camera, Time or Misc. Empty = all categories.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Keep only type names containing this text (case-insensitive), e.g. 'noise'. Empty = no filter.

tool_signatures.name: list_presets
tool_signatures.description: Lists the example projects shipped with IlluGen, usable as starting points.

search.description: Keep only presets whose name contains this text (case-insensitive). Empty = all presets.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Keep only presets whose name contains this text (case-insensitive). Empty = all presets.

tool_signatures.name: node_add
tool_signatures.description: Adds a node to the graph with IlluGen's default values, optionally setting some parameters.

node_type.description: Node type from list_node_types, e.g. 'Node_Grayscale_Noise' (case, spaces and 'Node_' prefix optional).

params.description: Parameter values to set, {name: value}, names and kinds from describe_node_type. Vectors and colors as lists ([x, y], [r, g, b, a]), enums as strings. Omitted parameters keep IlluGen's defaults.

label.description: Optional display label. A unique label can then replace the id in the other tools.

position.description: [x, y] position in the node editor. Default: to the right of the right-most node.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: Optional display label. A unique label can then replace the id in the other tools.

parameters.name: node_type
parameters.description: Node type from list_node_types, e.g. 'Node_Grayscale_Noise' (case, spaces and 'Node_' prefix optional).

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: Parameter values to set, {name: value}, names and kinds from describe_node_type. Vectors and colors as lists ([x, y], [r, g, b, a]), enums as strings. Omitted parameters keep IlluGen's defaults.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: [x, y] position in the node editor. Default: to the right of the right-most node.

tool_signatures.name: node_get
tool_signatures.description: Returns every detail of one node: parameter values, curves, gradients, spline points, pins and links.

tool_signatures.name: node_remove
tool_signatures.description: Deletes a node from the graph, with its outgoing links and every link from other nodes into it.

tool_signatures.name: node_set
tool_signatures.description: Changes an existing node's parameter values, label, position or disabled flag.

params.description: Parameter values to change, {name: value}, same format as node_add. Other parameters are left as is.

label.description: New display label; omit to keep it.

position.description: New [x, y] position; omit to keep it.

disabled.description: true bypasses the node in IlluGen (a disabled export node is skipped by project_render); false re-enables it; omit to keep it.

parameters.name: disabled
parameters.description: true bypasses the node in IlluGen (a disabled export node is skipped by project_render); false re-enables it; omit to keep it.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: New display label; omit to keep it.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: Parameter values to change, {name: value}, same format as node_add. Other parameters are left as is.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: New [x, y] position; omit to keep it.

tool_signatures.name: node_set_data
tool_signatures.description: Low-level escape hatch: overwrites one raw field of a node's internal data block.

key.description: Name of an existing field of the node's data block. An unknown name fails and lists the available fields.

value.description: New value as tagged JSON, in the same form node_get uses: vectors as {"__vec__": "f3", "v": [x, y, z]}.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Name of an existing field of the node's data block. An unknown name fails and lists the available fields.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: New value as tagged JSON, in the same form node_get uses: vectors as {"__vec__": "f3", "v": [x, y, z]}.

tool_signatures.name: project_new
tool_signatures.description: Creates a new .illugen project file, blank or copied from a preset or another project.

path.description: Absolute path of the project to create; must end in .illugen. Missing folders are created.

from_preset.description: Optional source to copy: a preset name from list_presets, or an absolute path to any .illugen file. Empty = blank project.

overwrite.description: Replace the file if it already exists (its previous content is lost). Default false: fail instead.

parameters.name: from_preset
parameters.description: Optional source to copy: a preset name from list_presets, or an absolute path to any .illugen file. Empty = blank project.

parameters.name: overwrite
parameters.description: Replace the file if it already exists (its previous content is lost). Default false: fail instead.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Absolute path of the project to create; must end in .illugen. Missing folders are created.

tool_signatures.name: project_normalize
tool_signatures.description: Loads the project in a private, invisible IlluGen and saves it back in place, the way IlluGen writes it.

tool_signatures.name: project_render
tool_signatures.description: Renders the project with the real IlluGen: runs the export of every enabled Node_Export_* node.

output_dir.description: Absolute folder to write every export to (created if needed). Empty = the folders set on the export nodes, usually next to the project.

timeout_s.description: Maximum time to wait for the export, in seconds.

preview.description: Attach a downscaled preview of the first exported image.

parameters.name: output_dir
parameters.description: Absolute folder to write every export to (created if needed). Empty = the folders set on the export nodes, usually next to the project.

parameters.name: preview
parameters.description: Attach a downscaled preview of the first exported image.

parameters.name: timeout_s
parameters.description: Maximum time to wait for the export, in seconds.

tool_signatures.name: project_screenshot
tool_signatures.description: Opens the project in a private, invisible IlluGen and returns a screenshot of its window.

width.description: Width of the invisible IlluGen window, in pixels.

height.description: Height of the invisible IlluGen window, in pixels.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Height of the invisible IlluGen window, in pixels.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Width of the invisible IlluGen window, in pixels.

tool_signatures.name: project_set_settings
tool_signatures.description: Changes project-wide settings: frame rate, animation loop region and default texture size.

loop_region.description: [start, end] of the animation loop, in seconds (e.g. [0, 2] = 2 s, 120 frames at 60 fps).

default_texture_width.description: Default texture width, a power-of-two enum string from '_1' to '_16384', e.g. '_512', '_1024', '_2048'.

default_texture_height.description: Default texture height, same values as default_texture_width.

parameters.name: default_texture_height
parameters.description: Default texture height, same values as default_texture_width.

parameters.name: default_texture_width
parameters.description: Default texture width, a power-of-two enum string from '_1' to '_16384', e.g. '_512', '_1024', '_2048'.

parameters.name: frames_per_second
parameters.description: Animation frame rate, e.g. 30 or 60.

parameters.name: loop_region
parameters.description: [start, end] of the animation loop, in seconds (e.g. [0, 2] = 2 s, 120 frames at 60 fps).

tool_signatures.name: project_summary
tool_signatures.description: Gives an overview of a project: its nodes, links, export settings, annotations and main settings.

tool_signatures.name: project_thumbnail
tool_signatures.description: Returns the preview image IlluGen embedded in the project file at its last save.

tool_signatures.name: project_validate
tool_signatures.description: Checks a project for problems before rendering it.

engine.description: Also check the project in the real IlluGen (slower, needs IlluGen installed). Default false: offline checks only.

parameters.name: engine
parameters.description: Also check the project in the real IlluGen (slower, needs IlluGen installed). Default false: offline checks only.

tool_signatures.name: spline_set
tool_signatures.description: Replaces the control points of a spline, sweep, point-shape or lattice node.

points.description: Control points in order: [x, y, z] in scene units for Grayscale_Spline, Geometry_Sweep and Geometry_Points_Shape; [x, y] in 0..1 for Utils_Lattice.

closed.description: Connect the last point back to the first (closed shape).

edges.description: Optional explicit segments [[i, j], ...] between point indexes, for branching shapes. Overrides the default chaining.

parameters.name: closed
parameters.description: Connect the last point back to the first (closed shape).

parameters.name: edges
parameters.description: Optional explicit segments [[i, j], ...] between point indexes, for branching shapes. Overrides the default chaining.

parameters.name: points
parameters.description: Control points in order: [x, y, z] in scene units for Grayscale_Spline, Geometry_Sweep and Geometry_Points_Shape; [x, y] in 0..1 for Utils_Lattice.

tool_signatures.description: Shows a parameter of a node inside a subgraph on the subgraph node itself, so it can be tweaked from outside.
